cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是 BBC 世界服务的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: I'm Valerie Sanderson, and at 14:00 GMT on Monday, the 24th of August, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是瓦莱丽·桑德森。以下是 8 月 24 日星期一格林尼治标准时间 14 点的主要新闻。

cues.en: The UK is handing over classified technology to Ukraine that would help Kyiv strike deeper into Russia.
cues.zh: 英国正向乌克兰移交机密技术，这将帮助基辅打击俄罗斯境内更深处的目标。

cues.en: Pakistan's army chief is back in Iran, trying to restart peace talks between Tehran and Washington.
cues.zh: 巴基斯坦陆军参谋长再次前往伊朗，试图重启德黑兰与华盛顿之间的和平谈判。

cues.en: Nine people have been killed amid a spike in piracy in the western Indian Ocean.
cues.zh: 西印度洋海盗活动激增，已有 9 人丧生。

cues.en: Also in this podcast: I'm ready to be executed, but not live with him.
cues.zh: 本期节目还将听到：我准备好接受处决，但不愿和他一起生活。

cues.en: Mr Governor, my honour and dignity have already been ruined by him.
cues.zh: 省长先生，我的荣誉和尊严已经被他毁掉了。

cues.en: The BBC gains rare access to the lives of people living in Afghanistan under Taliban rule.
cues.zh: BBC 获得难得的机会，了解塔利班统治下阿富汗民众的生活。

cues.en: Ukraine is hosting key European allies, known as the Coalition of the Willing, on the 35th anniversary of the nation's independence,
cues.zh: 乌克兰正在接待被称为“志愿者联盟”的欧洲主要盟友，适逢该国独立 35 周年，

cues.en: to press for more political support and, crucially, the critical weapons systems it needs to combat Russia.
cues.zh: 以争取更多政治支持，尤其是抗击俄罗斯所需的关键武器系统。

cues.en: The meeting is also expected to look at how to supply Ukraine with Patriot missiles that would intercept some of the aerial attacks from Russia.
cues.zh: 会议还预计将讨论如何向乌克兰提供爱国者导弹，以拦截俄罗斯发动的部分空袭。

cues.en: The event is chaired by the leaders of France and Germany, participating remotely, and by British Prime Minister Andy Burnham in Kyiv.
cues.zh: 这场活动由法国和德国领导人以及正在基辅的英国首相安迪·伯恩汉姆共同主持，法德领导人将远程参加。

cues.en: Thank you. Your incredible stand makes us stronger. Europe and NATO are stronger.
cues.zh: 谢谢你。你非凡的坚持让我们更加强大，欧洲和北约也是如此。

cues.en: As President Zelenskyy has said, Ukraine is not a poor relative but a strong ally.
cues.zh: 正如泽连斯基总统所说，乌克兰不是一个贫穷的亲戚，而是一个强大的盟友。

cues.en: I'd go further still.
cues.zh: 我还要更进一步地说。

cues.en: Ukraine has been Europe's protector, not a drain on our security, but the frontline of keeping Europe safe.
cues.zh: 乌克兰一直是欧洲的保护者，不是我们安全的负担，而是守护欧洲安全的前线。

cues.en: But this is not just a day for symbolic acts of support, as our correspondent in Kyiv, Dan Johnson, explains.
cues.zh: 但今天不仅是象征性支持的一天，驻基辅记者丹·约翰逊将为我们解释。

cues.en: There's a large security operation in Kyiv today for the Independence Day celebrations.
cues.zh: 今天基辅为独立日庆祝活动部署了大规模安保行动。

cues.en: A lot of international politicians and leaders are here, including British Prime Minister Andy Burnham on his first overseas visit.
cues.zh: 许多国际政界人士和领导人来到这里，其中包括首次出访的英国首相安迪·伯恩汉姆。

cues.en: He's bringing a message of renewed British support.
cues.zh: 他带来了英国重新支持乌克兰的信息。

cues.en: He said that friendship would be there for Ukraine as long as it takes,
cues.zh: 他说，无论需要多久，英国都会与乌克兰保持友谊，

cues.en: and that Russia's threats against the UK would not weaken the resolve that Britain would not waver in supplying Ukraine with what it needs.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯对英国的威胁不会削弱英国的决心，英国不会动摇，会继续向乌克兰提供所需的一切。

cues.en: And that's not just the Storm Shadow or SCALP missiles that have already been supplied,
cues.zh: 这不仅是已经提供的“风暴之影”或 SCALP 导弹，

cues.en: but it is now the technology, the blueprints for those missiles, so that Ukraine can produce them itself.
cues.zh: 现在提供的还包括这些导弹的技术和蓝图，让乌克兰能够自行生产。

cues.en: That's an important step, but it also signals to other international countries that Ukraine can be trusted with that technology.
cues.zh: 这是重要的一步，也向其他国家发出信号：乌克兰值得被信任，可以掌握这项技术。

cues.en: President Zelenskyy is hoping Donald Trump hears
cues.zh: 泽连斯基总统希望唐纳德·特朗普听到

cues.en: that message and therefore agrees that Ukraine can produce its own Patriot interceptors, desperately needed to protect Ukraine's skies.
cues.zh: 这一信息，并因此同意乌克兰生产自己的爱国者导弹拦截弹；乌克兰急需它们来保护领空。

cues.en: There are political meetings today as well as the celebrations.
cues.zh: 今天除了庆祝活动，还有政治会议。

cues.en: Andy Burnham will receive an award on behalf of the British people for the UK's support for Ukraine during the four-and-a-half-year war.
cues.zh: 安迪·伯恩汉姆将代表英国人民接受一项表彰，以感谢英国在这场战争的四年半时间里对乌克兰的支持。

cues.en: So what impact would the promised new defensive and offensive weapons have on Kyiv's military abilities?
cues.zh: 那么，承诺提供的新型防御和进攻武器将对基辅的军事能力产生什么影响？

cues.en: Volodymyr Havrylov is a former Ukrainian deputy minister of defence.
cues.zh: 弗拉基米尔·哈夫里洛夫曾任乌克兰国防部副部长。

cues.en: Russia doesn't have the capability to intercept ballistic missiles.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯没有拦截弹道导弹的能力。

cues.en: So they have some systems, but they are not as effective as Patriot, like that.
cues.zh: 所以他们虽然有一些系统，但效果不如爱国者导弹之类的系统。

cues.en: That's why it would be a kind of game changer
cues.zh: 所以这将成为一种改变局面的因素，

cues.en: when the first Ukrainian ballistic missile will reach some kind of targets close to Moscow,
cues.zh: 当第一枚乌克兰弹道导弹抵达莫斯科附近的某些目标时，

cues.en: with all this information coming inside Russian society to understand that something different is going on.
cues.zh: 这些信息传入俄罗斯社会，人们会明白，情况正在发生不同的变化。

cues.en: This war is all about reciprocity.
cues.zh: 这场战争关乎相互回应。

cues.en: So we didn't have any kind of capability to respond to Russian ballistic missiles.
cues.zh: 所以，在此之前，我们没有任何能力回应俄罗斯的弹道导弹。

cues.en: Or other attacks on our territory until 2026.
cues.zh: 直到2026年，我们也无法回应对我国领土的其他攻击。

cues.en: In 2026, we succeeded sufficiently to scale up the production of our domestic designs of long-range and middle-range drones.
cues.zh: 2026年，我们成功大幅扩大了国产远程和中程无人机的生产。

cues.en: And we also contributed a lot to the ballistic missile programme in Ukraine, and to cruise missiles.
cues.zh: 我们还为乌克兰的弹道导弹项目和巡航导弹项目作出了很大贡献。

cues.en: It gave us the capability to reach Russian targets on the territory of Russia, deep in Russia.
cues.zh: 这使我们有能力打击俄罗斯境内、俄罗斯腹地的目标。

cues.en: And we immediately started to understand that that is a game changer.
cues.zh: 我们很快开始意识到，这改变了战局。

cues.en: The Russians started to react differently inside the country about that.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯人开始在国内对此作出不同反应。

cues.en: And we are very confident that the next step, ballistic capability, will contribute to the outcome of this war.
cues.zh: 我们非常确信，下一步发展弹道导弹能力将影响这场战争的结果。

cues.en: Volodymyr Havrylov.
cues.zh: 弗拉基米尔·哈夫里洛夫。

cues.en: Pakistani mediators are in Iran, trying to restart the peace process between Tehran and Washington.
cues.zh: 巴基斯坦斡旋人员正在伊朗，试图重启德黑兰与华盛顿之间的和平进程。

cues.en: It comes as the US is preparing to expand its economic sanctions.
cues.zh: 此时美国正准备扩大经济制裁。

cues.en: That could see nations that trade with Iran hit with financial penalties.
cues.zh: 这可能导致与伊朗进行贸易的国家遭受经济处罚。

cues.en: The US Treasury Secretary, Scott Bessent, says they will be the toughest in history.
cues.zh: 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特说，这将是历史上最严厉的制裁。

cues.en: In anticipation, the country's currency, the rial, has hit a record low.
cues.zh: 在这一预期下，该国货币里亚尔跌至历史最低点。

cues.en: The Iranian President, Masoud Pezeshkian, says the nation stands firm in the face of aggression.
cues.zh: 伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽希齐扬说，面对侵略，国家立场坚定。

cues.en: The perception from the US was that Iran would become Venezuela.
cues.zh: 美国当时的看法是，伊朗会变成委内瑞拉。

cues.en: Not only has this not happened, but
cues.zh: 但这不仅没有发生，

cues.en: Iran has become a power that's astonished the world with its display of resistance, solidarity and integrity.
cues.zh: 伊朗还凭借展现出的抵抗、团结与正直，成为令世界惊叹的力量。

cues.en: We are in an all-out military, economic and security war in the face of the most devastating set of sanctions.
cues.zh: 面对最具破坏性的一系列制裁，我们正处于一场全面的军事、经济和安全战争中。

cues.en: But we're standing firm to secure the future of our people.
cues.zh: 但我们立场坚定，要保障人民的未来。

cues.en: I asked Taraneh Fathalian from BBC Persian what appetite there is in Tehran for a diplomatic solution to the conflict.
cues.zh: 我问BBC波斯语部的塔拉内·法塔利安，德黑兰对外交解决冲突有多大意愿。

cues.en: What we hear from different officials in Iran, we can kind of feel that
cues.zh: 我们从伊朗不同官员那里听到的消息，让我们大致感觉到，

cues.en: there is no consensus and there's a division.
cues.zh: 那里没有共识，存在分歧。

cues.en: Officials are divided between whether they should make a deal or carry the war.
cues.zh: 官员们分成两派：是应该达成协议，还是继续战争。

cues.en: A few days ago, President Pezeshkian said that we have to get out while we're on top.
cues.zh: 几天前，佩泽希齐扬总统说，我们必须趁占据上风时退出。

cues.en: We have to end the war while we're on top.
cues.zh: 我们必须趁占据上风时结束战争。

cues.en: And then the Iranian Majlis speaker Ghalibaf said in Baghdad that if people are hungry,
cues.zh: 随后，伊朗议会议长加利巴夫在巴格达说，如果人民挨饿，

cues.en: we can't continue, we can't last.
cues.zh: 我们就无法继续，也撑不下去。

cues.en: After massive backlash from Iranian hardline officials, who said this showed weakness,
cues.zh: 伊朗强硬派官员强烈反弹，称这显示了软弱，

cues.en: the Majlis released a long video of the remarks made by the Iranian Majlis speaker Ghalibaf.
cues.zh: 伊朗议会于是发布了一段长视频，内容是议长加利巴夫的讲话。

cues.en: He said that it's important that we stand firm where we are, and security is just as important as financial stability.
cues.zh: 他说，重要的是我们要坚持立场，安全与金融稳定同等重要。

cues.en: So they're kind of showing a tough facade, but underneath that they are aware that the economy is crippled.
cues.zh: 所以，他们表面上显得强硬，但内心清楚经济已经陷入瘫痪。

cues.en: Well, the rial, I think, is at a record low.
cues.zh: 里亚尔，我想，已经跌至历史最低点。

cues.en: What is life like there for people in Iran? Because I know you've been talking to them.
cues.zh: 伊朗民众的生活是什么样的？我知道你一直在和他们交谈。

cues.en: It wasn't long ago that I saw a video online of this young woman who had bought
cues.zh: 不久前，我在网上看到一段视频：一名年轻女子买了，

cues.en: chicken bones from a butcher's, basically the waste of chicken that wasn't being sold.
cues.zh: 从肉店买来的鸡骨头，基本上是卖不出去的鸡肉废料。

cues.en: She had bought that from the butchers and was boiling that so she could get
cues.zh: 她从肉店买来这些东西煮沸，好从中获得，

cues.en: some nutrients out of it, because chicken has got so expensive.
cues.zh: 一些营养，因为鸡肉已经贵得买不起了。

cues.en: People are talking about eggs, because meat and red meat has been off limits
cues.zh: 人们在谈论鸡蛋，因为肉类，尤其是红肉，已经超出，

cues.en: for a lot of Iranian families now, so they were resorting to eggs for nutrients and protein, and even that is off limits.
cues.zh: 许多伊朗家庭的承受能力，只好改吃鸡蛋获取营养和蛋白质，但连鸡蛋也吃不起了。

cues.en: People are talking about devastating poverty, and these are people who were middle class not long ago.
cues.zh: 人们谈论的是毁灭性的贫困，而这些人不久前还属于中产阶级。

cues.en: It's very tough. I see videos of shopkeepers saying they've kept their shop open for days but haven't seen one customer.
cues.zh: 情况非常艰难。我看到店主说，他们的店开了好几天，却一个顾客也没见到。

cues.en: So people are really feeling the effects of the war. Taraneh Fathalian.
cues.zh: 所以，人们确实深切感受到战争的影响。塔拉内·法塔利安。

cues.en: The BBC World Service has gained rare access inside Afghanistan under the Taliban.
cues.zh: BBC世界服务部罕见地获准进入塔利班统治下的阿富汗。

cues.en: Five years after the extreme Islamist movement returned to power,
cues.zh: 这个极端伊斯兰主义运动重新掌权五年后，

cues.en: the BBC has spent time with senior figures there, former insurgents turned politicians,
cues.zh: BBC与当地高层人物相处，其中包括从叛乱分子转为政治家的前成员，

cues.en: to see how they are governing a country in crisis.
cues.zh: 以了解他们如何治理这个陷入危机的国家。

cues.en: We've also spoken to Afghans themselves, living once again under the same hardline rule the group first imposed decades ago.
cues.zh: 我们还采访了阿富汗人，他们再次生活在这个组织数十年前首次施加的同样严厉的统治下。

cues.en: The BBC's Kawoon Khamush reports.
cues.zh: BBC记者卡温·卡穆什报道。

cues.en: In Sheberghan, northern Afghanistan, Taliban Governor Abdul Ahad Sarhadi starts his day.
cues.zh: 在阿富汗北部的谢伯尔甘，塔利班省长阿卜杜勒·阿哈德·萨尔哈迪开始了一天的工作。

cues.en: Once a Guantanamo Bay detainee, Sarhadi now works for the country's supreme leader, enforcing strict Sharia in his region.
cues.zh: 萨尔哈迪曾是关塔那摩湾的囚犯，如今为该国最高领袖工作，在当地执行严格的伊斯兰教法。

cues.en: The BBC has been given rare access to his office to film some of his daily work.
cues.zh: BBC获准罕见地进入他的办公室，拍摄他的一些日常工作。

cues.en: As he meets local people who come to him seeking resolutions to various problems.
cues.zh: 他会见前来寻求解决各种问题的当地民众。

cues.en: Go back with you.
cues.zh: 和你一起回去。

cues.en: One case dominates the day, however: that of an eighteen-year-old woman.
cues.zh: 不过，有一个案件占据了这一天：一名18岁的女子。

cues.en: She is seeking a divorce from her husband, accusing him of abuse and beatings.
cues.zh: 她指控丈夫虐待并殴打自己，正在寻求离婚。

cues.en: She is wearing a full veil and sunglasses, her clasped hands in black gloves.
cues.zh: 她戴着全套面纱和太阳镜，交握的双手戴着黑色手套。

cues.en: To protect her identity, we have had someone else voice her words.
cues.zh: 为了保护她的身份，我们请别人替她配音。

cues.en: I am ready to be executed, but not live with him.
cues.zh: 我宁愿被处决，也不愿和他一起生活。

cues.en: The governor tells her she should either continue the marriage
cues.zh: 省长告诉她，要么继续这段婚姻，

cues.en: or apply for a khul'a, a wife-initiated divorce that may require repaying her dowry to her husband. Under the Taliban, getting a divorce is very difficult for a woman
cues.zh: 要么申请 khul'a，即由妻子提出的离婚，这可能要求她把嫁妆退还给丈夫。在塔利班统治下，女性很难获得离婚，

cues.en: without the husband's consent. Despite this, she wants to proceed.
cues.zh: 除非得到丈夫同意。尽管如此，她仍想继续申请。

cues.en: Ask yourself who would marry me after I get my divorce.
cues.zh: 你想想，我离婚后谁会娶我？

cues.en: You'll have to compromise a lot, or you'll lose your dignity and honor.
cues.zh: 你得作出很多妥协，否则会失去尊严和荣誉。

cues.en: Mr Governor, my honor and dignity have already been ruined by him.
cues.zh: 省长先生，我的荣誉和尊严已经被他毁掉了。

cues.en: Dismissing her to the next room, the governor discusses the matter with male officials, bodyguards and her husband.
cues.zh: 让她到隔壁房间后，省长与男性官员、保镖和她的丈夫讨论此事。

cues.en: Women are mindless. They are deficient in intellect. They don't know a thing.
cues.zh: 女人没有头脑，缺乏才智，什么都不懂。

cues.en: What would you do with a divorced daughter? You can't kill her.
cues.zh: 有个离婚的女儿，你会怎么办？你不能杀了她。

cues.en: You need to marry her with someone else. Would you marry such a girl with your son?
cues.zh: 你得把她嫁给别人。你会让自己的儿子娶这样的女孩吗？

cues.en: The woman's father says they will continue to fight for the separation.
cues.zh: 这名女子的父亲说，他们会继续争取分居。

cues.en: The Taliban's policies today are similar to the hardline interpretation of Islamic religious law they imposed in the 1990s,
cues.zh: 今天塔利班的政策，类似于他们在上世纪90年代推行的强硬伊斯兰宗教法解释，

cues.en: and those who oppose them have gone into hiding, especially women who have been erased from public life.
cues.zh: 反对他们的人已经躲藏起来，尤其是被逐出公共生活的女性。

cues.en: When they do fight back, they face harsh crackdowns.
cues.zh: 她们一旦反抗，就会遭到严厉镇压。

cues.en: In the week the Taliban came to power, many women took to the streets to protest.
cues.zh: 塔利班掌权后的那一周，许多女性走上街头抗议。

cues.en: Hoda had a successful career and an active life, but now we meet in secret.
cues.zh: 霍达曾有成功的事业和积极的生活，如今我们秘密会面。

cues.en: We have changed her name and voice to protect her safety.
cues.zh: 我们改变了她的姓名和声音，以保护她的安全。

cues.en: Why do you think the Taliban want to restrict women? I ask her.
cues.zh: 我问她：“你认为塔利班为什么想限制女性？”

cues.en: I think the Taliban are scared.
cues.zh: 我认为塔利班感到害怕。

cues.en: They are scared of educated women.
cues.zh: 他们害怕受过教育的女性。

cues.en: They know educated women won't give birth to ignorant beings, such as the Taliban.
cues.zh: 他们知道，受过教育的女性不会生下像塔利班那样无知的人。

cues.en: They restrict women so they wouldn't be able to raise wise men, because that would be the end of the Taliban.
cues.zh: 他们限制女性，让她们无法培养有智慧的男性，因为那将意味着塔利班的终结。

cues.en: Upon returning to power, the Taliban said they had changed.
cues.zh: 重新掌权后，塔利班说他们已经改变。

cues.en: Five years on, it's a country run by men, for men.
cues.zh: 五年过去，这是一个由男性管理、为男性服务的国家。

cues.en: In a lavish press centre funded by the Americans for the previous government, we sit down with the public face of the Taliban,
cues.zh: 在美国为前政府资助的豪华新闻中心，我们与塔利班的公开代表坐下来交谈，

cues.en: their spokesman known as Zabihullah Mujahid.
cues.zh: 他就是被称为 Zabihullah Mujahid 的发言人。

cues.en: You promised that you will respect human rights, you will allow women to participate in all aspects of life, work and study.
cues.zh: 你曾承诺尊重人权，允许女性参与生活、工作和学习的各个方面。

cues.en: Why did you fail to keep your promise?
cues.zh: 你为什么没能兑现承诺？

cues.en: I mentioned Sharia as a condition.
cues.zh: 我提到过，条件是遵循伊斯兰教法。

cues.en: We are committed to women's rights, freedom of speech and other things within Sharia.
cues.zh: 我们致力于保障女性权利、言论自由以及伊斯兰教法框架内的其他权利。

cues.en: We must scale everything up according to Sharia.
cues.zh: 我们必须按照伊斯兰教法扩大这一切。

cues.en: As an insurgency, the Taliban proved they could survive.
cues.zh: 作为一个叛乱组织，塔利班证明了自己能够生存下来。

cues.en: The question now is whether they can govern a country in crisis, and for how long.
cues.zh: 现在的问题是，他们能否治理一个陷入危机的国家，以及能维持多久。

cues.en: Kawoon Khamush.
cues.zh: Kawoon Khamush 报道。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast: what blue and green check moquette was originally commissioned for the launch of the Victoria Line,
cues.zh: 本期播客稍后将介绍：哪种蓝绿色格纹座椅织物原本为维多利亚线开通而设计，

cues.en: but because it wasn't ready in time, an existing design was used instead?
cues.zh: 但由于未能及时完成，最终改用了已有的设计？

cues.en: Straub. Yes, the quiz show contestant who went viral for having the most niche specialism ever.
cues.zh: Straub。没错，这位竞猜节目选手因拥有史上最小众的专长而走红。

cues.en: Piracy was a major threat to international shipping off Somalia between 2008 and 2018.
cues.zh: 2008年至2018年间，索马里附近的海盗活动曾严重威胁国际航运。

cues.en: Now, the western Indian Ocean is seeing a spike in piracy incidents again, after years of relative containment.
cues.zh: 在相对受控多年后，印度洋西部的海盗事件再次激增。

cues.en: Six ships are being held by hijackers, and a drone strike on a vessel which was believed to be part of a piracy supply chain killed nine people on Sunday.
cues.zh: 目前有六艘船被劫持者扣押；周日，一艘被认为属于海盗补给链的船遭无人机袭击，造成9人死亡。

cues.en: Vice Admiral Ignacio Villanueva Serrano is from the EU's anti-piracy Operation Atalanta.
cues.zh: 伊格纳西奥·比利亚努埃瓦·塞拉诺海军中将来自欧盟反海盗行动“阿塔兰塔”。

cues.en: One skiff full of nine people has been destroyed in close proximity to one of the vessels that was pirated.
cues.zh: 一艘载有9人的小艇在一艘被劫船只附近被摧毁。

cues.en: As you know, right now we have six of them, and this skiff has been related to one of them.
cues.zh: 如你所知，目前有6艘，而这艘小艇与其中一艘有关。

cues.en: Our Africa correspondent, Barbara Plett-Usher, told me more.
cues.zh: 我们的非洲记者芭芭拉·普莱特-厄舍为我作了进一步介绍。

cues.en: So the strike killed nine people on Somalia's northeastern coast, and a Puntland security official—this is a semi-autonomous region in Somalia—
cues.zh: 这次袭击造成索马里东北海岸9人死亡。一名邦特兰安全官员——该地区是索马里的半自治区域——

cues.en: told us that the men had been preparing to board this to go out to sea. He said they were all armed,
cues.zh: 告诉我们，这些人准备登上小艇出海。他说他们都携带武器，

cues.en: so very likely they were pirates or at least part of a pirate network.
cues.zh: 因此他们很可能是海盗，至少属于海盗网络。

cues.en: And this is the second such attack in a week.
cues.zh: 这是一个星期内发生的第二起此类袭击。

cues.en: Although no one has claimed responsibility for them, they seem to be linked to one of the vessels that was hijacked last week, the Lutuf.
cues.zh: 虽然无人宣称对袭击负责，但它们似乎与上周被劫持的“Lutuf”号有关。

cues.en: It was flying a Cameroon flag, but there are reports—unconfirmed reports—that it has links to Turkey.
cues.zh: 它悬挂喀麦隆国旗，但有报道称——尚未证实——它与土耳其有关联。

cues.en: So possibly these boats were hit because they were aimed at supplying that ship.
cues.zh: 所以，这些船可能因计划为那艘船提供补给而遭到袭击。

cues.en: The Puntland security official said he believed it was a Turkish drone.
cues.zh: 邦特兰安全官员称，他认为那是一架土耳其无人机。

cues.en: Again, we have no confirmation of that.
cues.zh: 不过，我们仍未证实这一点。

cues.en: So the Lutuf is one of, I think now, five ships that are being held by the pirates,
cues.zh: 所以，“Lutuf”号是目前被海盗扣押的、我想共有5艘船中的一艘，

cues.en: and they have been hijacked over the course of several months,
cues.zh: 这些船是在数月间陆续被劫持的，

cues.en: and we know for some of them, the pirates are asking for quite steep ransoms.
cues.zh: 我们知道，海盗向其中一些船索要高额赎金。

cues.en: What's behind this surge in piracy, do you think, in this part of the world?
cues.zh: 你认为，世界这一区域的海盗活动为何激增？

cues.en: Well, there are a number of things. One of them is the general security environment.
cues.zh: 原因有很多，其中之一是整体安全环境。

cues.en: So you have a maritime blockade on the Strait of Hormuz.
cues.zh: 比如，霍尔木兹海峡遭到海上封锁。

cues.en: You have conflict in the Red Sea,
cues.zh: 红海存在冲突，

cues.en: and so that, I think, has pushed more and more international vessels closer to the Somali coast in terms of the routes that they are taking.
cues.zh: 我认为，这使越来越多的国际船只在航线上靠近索马里海岸。

cues.en: Plus, it's believed that that has distracted some of the international forces,
cues.zh: 此外，人们认为这分散了部分国际部队的注意力，

cues.en: who would normally be policing the pirates and piracy to be dealing with these other issues.
cues.zh: 它们本来会负责打击海盗，却转而处理这些其他问题。

cues.en: So that has created an environment of opportunity, shall we say.
cues.zh: 可以说，这就创造了可乘之机。

cues.en: Analysts are suspicious about a number of ships that have been hijacked near Yemen's coast.
cues.zh: 分析人士怀疑，也门海岸附近有多艘船遭到劫持。

cues.en: They think this might show some collaboration between the Somali pirates and the Houthi rebels in Yemen,
cues.zh: 他们认为，这或许显示索马里海盗与也门胡塞武装存在合作，

cues.en: that they are perhaps collaborating to take advantage of the environment to make maximum profit.
cues.zh: 双方可能正合作利用这一环境，以获取最大利润。

cues.en: Again, that hasn't been confirmed, but there is also a local element to this.
cues.zh: 同样，这尚未得到证实，但其中也有当地因素。

cues.en: You have foreign trawlers fishing in the shores off of Somalia, and that has really been a blow to the fishing industry and to incomes of fishermen.
cues.zh: 索马里近海有外国拖网渔船作业，这严重打击了当地渔业和渔民收入。

cues.en: So it means that they're more ready to take up piracy for income.
cues.zh: 这意味着他们更愿意靠海盗活动谋生。

cues.en: Barbara Plett-Usher.
cues.zh: 芭芭拉·普莱特-厄舍。

cues.en: The online fast-fashion retailer SHEIN will make its long-awaited market debut on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at the beginning of September.
cues.zh: 线上快时尚零售商 SHEIN 将于9月初在香港交易所期待已久地上市。

cues.en: Some analysts say it could be one of the biggest listings of company shares anywhere in the world this year.
cues.zh: 一些分析人士称，这可能是今年全球规模最大的公司上市之一。

cues.en: The company, known for selling dresses for about $10 and jeans for about $15,
cues.zh: 这家公司以约10美元售卖连衣裙、约15美元售卖牛仔裤而闻名，

cues.en: was founded in China, but it now has its headquarters in Singapore.
cues.zh: 它成立于中国，但总部如今位于新加坡。

cues.en: Our reporter, Ajuma Ndukwe, has been following the story.
cues.zh: 我们的记者阿朱玛·恩杜克韦一直在跟进此事。

cues.en: So we know that SHEIN, which is a Chinese fast-fashion brand,
cues.zh: 我们知道，SHEIN 是一家中国快时尚品牌，

cues.en: is releasing 280 million shares, which are going to be valued at around $6 per share.
cues.zh: 此次将发行2.8亿股，定价约为每股6美元。

cues.en: What's particularly interesting about this listing is that the company is valued at around $27 billion US dollars,
cues.zh: 这次上市尤其值得关注的是，公司估值约为270亿美元，

cues.en: which is absolutely huge.
cues.zh: 这实在非常高。

cues.en: I mean, it makes it, you know, much more valuable than Zara, which is a household name, which is a Spanish company.
cues.zh: 它的估值明显高于家喻户晓的西班牙公司 Zara。

cues.en: However, back in 2022, it was valued at nearly $100 billion US dollars.
cues.zh: 然而，2022年它的估值曾接近1000亿美元。

cues.en: So that's a significant fall in value, and that's come about for a number of reasons.
cues.zh: 所以估值大幅下降，原因有很多。

cues.en: Tell us why. I mean, what's gone wrong for the brand?
cues.zh: 为什么？也就是说，这个品牌出了什么问题？

cues.en: Well, we saw that when SHEIN released its company results, we saw that sales had slowed down.
cues.zh: 我们看到，SHEIN 发布业绩后，销售额已经放缓。

cues.en: And part of that is because the US removed an import duty exemption on small packages,
cues.zh: 部分原因是美国取消了小包裹的进口关税豁免，

cues.en: which made it much more expensive to order goods from the brand.
cues.zh: 从该品牌订购商品的成本因此大幅上升。

cues.en: And it removed the fashion brand's competitive advantage.
cues.zh: 这也削弱了该时尚品牌的竞争优势。

cues.en: As a result of this, SHEIN has said that it has to review its prices
cues.zh: 因此，SHEIN表示必须重新审视价格。

cues.en: across the US market to try and offset those costs.
cues.zh: 覆盖美国市场，以抵消这些成本。

cues.en: Another problem with their operating costs is that, due to the war in Iran,
cues.zh: 它们运营成本的另一个问题是，受伊朗战争影响，

cues.en: like many companies around the world, it has pushed up the cost of doing business, and that's had an impact on their operating costs.
cues.zh: 与世界各地许多公司一样，这推高了经营成本，也影响了SHEIN的运营成本。

cues.en: Also, there's Temu, which you may have heard of. It's another Chinese company which offers fast fashion.
cues.zh: 此外还有你可能听说过的Temu。这是另一家提供快时尚商品的中国公司。

cues.en: They've become a major competitor for SHEIN, and they've taken some of SHEIN's market share.
cues.zh: Temu已成为SHEIN的主要竞争对手，并夺走了SHEIN的一些市场份额。

cues.en: And of course, all of this comes at a time of huge uncertainty
cues.zh: 当然，这一切发生在极大的不确定性之中，

cues.en: because we've been seeing a tit-for-tat tariff war play out between the US and China,
cues.zh: 因为我们一直看到美国与中国之间的针锋相对的关税战不断上演，

cues.en: which is currently paused, but as we all know, that can restart at any time. Ajuma Ndukwe.
cues.zh: 目前关税战暂时停摆，但众所周知，随时可能重启。阿朱玛·恩杜克韦。

cues.en: One of the world's most agile birds, the Montagu's harrier, is becoming a less common sight
cues.zh: 世界上最敏捷的鸟类之一，Montagu鹞，在人们眼中正变得越来越少见，

cues.en: in northern Europe in the summer, when it arrives to breed.
cues.zh: 它夏季抵达北欧繁殖。

cues.en: It's a long-distance migrant, which then travels to Africa for the winter.
cues.zh: 它是长途候鸟，随后前往非洲过冬。

cues.en: The bird of prey's nests are on the ground, most often in agricultural farmland.
cues.zh: 这种猛禽在地面筑巢，通常位于农业用地。

cues.en: Now, earlier harvests brought forward by climate change mean the nests and the chicks are often at risk of being destroyed by farm machinery.
cues.zh: 如今，气候变化导致收割提前，意味着鸟巢和雏鸟常有被农机摧毁的风险。

cues.en: In the UK, Montagu's harriers are extremely rare,
cues.zh: 在英国，Montagu鹞极为罕见；

cues.en: but the largest conservation charity here in Britain, the Royal Society for the Protection of Birds,
cues.zh: 但英国最大的自然保护慈善机构皇家鸟类保护协会，

cues.en: has found two nests with chicks and has given exclusive access to the BBC's climate editor, Justin Rowlatt.
cues.zh: 发现了两个有雏鸟的巢，并向BBC气候事务编辑贾斯廷·罗拉特提供独家采访机会。

cues.en: Easy, easy, easy. There she is.
cues.zh: 慢点，慢点，慢点。她在那里。

cues.en: God, they're beautiful birds, aren't they?
cues.zh: 天哪，它们真是漂亮的鸟，不是吗？

cues.en: Absolutely the best, yeah.
cues.zh: 确实是最棒的，是啊。

cues.en: RSPB experts are fitting a female Montagu's harrier with a tiny satellite tag that sits on her back like a rucksack.
cues.zh: 英国皇家鸟类保护协会的专家正给一只雌性Montagu鹞安装微型卫星标签，像背包一样置于它背上。

cues.en: She is still a chick, with wisps of fluffy baby down amongst her dappled brown feathers,
cues.zh: 它还是一只雏鸟，斑驳的棕色羽毛间夹杂着绒绒的幼羽，

cues.en: but you can see the sleek aerial athlete she'll become.
cues.zh: 但你可以看出它将成为一名轻盈的空中健将。

cues.en: Fully grown, she'll weigh barely a third of a kilo, yet her wings will stretch more than a metre.
cues.zh: 成年后，它的体重不到三分之一公斤，但翼展会超过一米。

cues.en: The RSPB's experts want to understand more about the astonishing journey these birds, so desperately rare in the UK, make.
cues.zh: 英国皇家鸟类保护协会专家想进一步了解这些在英国极其罕见的鸟类经历的惊人旅程。

cues.en: So we've come to a top-secret location. All I can say is that we're somewhere in England.
cues.zh: 所以我们来到一个绝密地点。我只能说我们在英格兰某处。

cues.en: I've been told not even to mention the county,
cues.zh: 有人告诉我，连所在郡都不能提，

cues.en: because this bird is so rare that if bird spotters knew where it was.
cues.zh: 因为这种鸟太罕见了，一旦观鸟者知道它在哪里，

cues.en: They would come there, not just in their hundreds, but in their thousands.
cues.zh: 他们会赶来，人数不只是几百，而是几千。

cues.en: And these birds, these Montagu's harriers, already have it really tough.
cues.zh: 而这些Montagu鹞已经处境艰难。

cues.en: As recently as a few years ago, for about a five-year period, none were breeding in the UK.
cues.zh: 就在几年前，约有五年时间没有一只在英国繁殖。

cues.en: Down from as many as 12 or 15 breeding pairs in the nineties.
cues.zh: 而上世纪90年代曾有多达12到15对繁殖。

cues.en: The bird's feeding behaviour is extraordinary.
cues.zh: 这种鸟的觅食行为非常特别。

cues.en: The male is supporting two females and six chicks across two nests, and he can make up to ten food deliveries a day.
cues.zh: 这只雄鸟要供养两个巢中的两只雌鸟和六只雏鸟，每天最多送食十次。

cues.en: He swoops in carrying prey in his claws, drops it mid-air, and the female twists beneath him to snatch it as it falls.
cues.zh: 它俯冲而来，爪中带着猎物，在半空将其放下，雌鸟在它下方翻转，接住掉落的猎物。

cues.en: This isn't the first time the RSPB has encountered the male bird, says Mark Thomas, who is head of investigations at the charity.
cues.zh: 该协会调查主管马克·托马斯说，这不是英国皇家鸟类保护协会第一次遇到这只雄鸟。

cues.en: The male here is an incredibly special bird.
cues.zh: 这里的雄鸟非常特别。

cues.en: So this was ringed as a chick in Wiltshire in 2016, and I was present when that bird was ringed. And he's come back this year.
cues.zh: 它2016年还是雏鸟时在威尔特郡被戴上环，我当时在场。今年它又回来了。

cues.en: He spent 10 days displaying like crazy in the sky at several thousand feet and amazingly attracted two female Montagu's harriers.
cues.zh: 它在数千英尺高空疯狂炫技求偶了10天，竟吸引了两只雌性Montagu鹞。

cues.en: Montagu's harriers nest on the ground, hidden among the crops, and climate change is bringing harvests forward.
cues.zh: Montagu鹞在地面筑巢，藏在庄稼之间，而气候变化正使收割提前。

cues.en: The harvest here, for example, this year was like a month earlier than in previous years.
cues.zh: 例如，这里的收割今年比往年早了大约一个月。

cues.en: So it almost puts any Montagu's harrier nest at the peril of inadvertently being destroyed by farm machinery.
cues.zh: 因此，任何Montagu鹞的巢都几乎面临被农机意外摧毁的危险。

cues.en: If the nests aren't found, the chicks would be killed by the combines.
cues.zh: 如果找不到鸟巢，雏鸟就会被联合收割机杀死。

cues.en: But surviving the harvest is just the first hurdle, which is where that satellite tag comes in.
cues.zh: 但熬过收割只是第一道难关，这正是卫星标签发挥作用的地方。

cues.en: Two of the chicks are getting them because soon they will be leaving Britain.
cues.zh: 其中两只雏鸟会安装标签，因为它们很快就要离开英国。

cues.en: We know adult birds migrate thousands of miles to West Africa, but much less is known about the young birds, says Thomas.
cues.zh: 托马斯说，我们知道成年鸟会迁徙数千英里到西非，但对幼鸟所知甚少。

cues.en: It will show us, for the first time, where they're going,
cues.zh: 这将让我们第一次知道它们要去哪里，

cues.en: what route they'll take, how long they'll stay, and if they'll return to the UK in year one or two?
cues.zh: 迁徙路线、停留多久，以及它们会在第一年还是第二年回到英国？

cues.en: And all of that information is the bit that's missing from the jigsaw.
cues.zh: 而所有这些信息正是这幅拼图中缺失的部分。

cues.en: Within weeks, these juvenile birds will be heading south.
cues.zh: 几周内，这些幼鸟就将南飞。

cues.en: And now, for the first time, the RSPB will be able to follow
cues.zh: 现在，英国皇家鸟类保护协会将首次能够追踪，

cues.en: two of them into the unknown. Justin Rowlatt.
cues.zh: 其中两只鸟踏入未知之旅。贾斯廷·罗拉特。

cues.en: The British quiz show Mastermind has a simple format that's been replicated around the world.
cues.zh: 英国智力问答节目《Mastermind》的形式很简单，已被世界各地的节目沿用。

cues.en: The contestant chooses a specialist subject for one round, which can be anything, and under a stark spotlight is peppered with quickfire questions.
cues.zh: 参赛者为其中一轮选择一个专业主题，可以是任何内容，然后在强烈聚光灯下接受一连串快问快答。

cues.en: One contestant has gone viral for her topic of choice: Transport for London moquettes.
cues.zh: 一位参赛者因她选择的主题走红：伦敦交通局的座椅织物。

cues.en: What's a moquette, I hear you ask? Well, it's the thick, durable fabric seen on public transport seats all over the world.
cues.zh: 你可能会问，moquette 是什么？它就是世界各地公共交通座椅上那种厚实耐用的织物。

cues.en: Here's student Emily Medhurst, TfL fabric enthusiast, in the famous Mastermind black chair.
cues.zh: 坐在《Mastermind》著名黑色椅子上的，是学生、伦敦交通局织物爱好者艾米莉·梅德赫斯特。

cues.en: What blue and green check moquette was originally commissioned for the launch of the Victoria line?
cues.zh: 哪种蓝绿色格纹织物原本是为维多利亚线开通而委托设计的？

cues.en: But because it wasn't ready in time, an existing design was used instead.
cues.zh: 但因为没能及时完成，最后采用了现有的设计。

cues.en: Straub. Yes.
cues.zh: Straub。是的。

cues.en: The 1940s moquette known as Roundel or Bullseye was originally attributed to Eddie Chapman,
cues.zh: 被称为 Roundel 或 Bullseye 的 20 世纪40年代织物，最初被认为出自埃迪·查普曼之手，

cues.en: but was later discovered to be the work of which other designer? Joy Jarvis.
cues.zh: 但后来发现它其实是哪位设计师的作品？乔伊·贾维斯。

cues.en: It was Joy Jarvis. Emily and one of TfL's fabric experts spoke to Henry Zeffman.
cues.zh: 答案是乔伊·贾维斯。艾米莉和伦敦交通局的一位织物专家接受了亨利·泽夫曼的采访。

cues.en: I've always been interested in textiles and design, and growing up in London, I've loved TfL.
cues.zh: 我一直对纺织品和设计感兴趣，在伦敦长大，也一直很喜欢伦敦交通局。

cues.en: And I went to an open day at the Acton Depot a few years ago, and they had a stand about moquette,
cues.zh: 几年前，我去了阿克顿车库的开放日，那里有一个介绍 moquette 的展台，

cues.en: and I was like, wow, this is the perfect marriage of like my two interests.
cues.zh: 我当时就想，哇，这正好把我的两大兴趣结合在了一起。

cues.en: I think it was a bit of a slow-blossoming interest,
cues.zh: 我觉得这是一种慢慢萌发的兴趣，

cues.en: and I think it's like once you realize it's there,
cues.zh: 我想，一旦你意识到它的存在，

cues.en: you realize how much unique design there is across the network in the seats, and like in the posters and everything.
cues.zh: 你就会发现，整个交通网络的座椅、海报和各种地方都有多少独特的设计。

cues.en: And what those who haven't watched your episode of Mastermind won't know is
cues.zh: 没看过你那一期《Mastermind》的人不知道的是，

cues.en: that you were wearing a vest inspired by the London Overground moquette
cues.zh: 你当时穿着一件受伦敦地上铁座椅织物启发的背心，

cues.en: while you were in the chair being grilled by Clive Myrie. That's right, isn't it?
cues.zh: 坐在椅子上接受克莱夫·迈里盘问时就是这样，对吧？

cues.en: Yes, yeah, yeah. That was my number one priority when I got told I was going to be on the show: something to wear.
cues.zh: 对，对，对。得知我要上节目时，我最优先考虑的就是要做一件穿的东西。

cues.en: Oh, you made it yourself?
cues.zh: 哦，是你自己做的吗？

cues.en: Yes. Yeah, yeah, so I, yeah, it took precedence over the revision a little bit, but yeah, I made it myself.
cues.zh: 对，对，对。所以确实有点优先做这个，复习就往后放了一点，但这件背心是我自己做的。

cues.en: Okay. Well, you may well then be giving our next guest, Anna Clough, from Camira, a run for her money
cues.zh: 好吧。那你或许会让我们的下一位嘉宾、来自 Camira 的安娜·克拉夫感到竞争压力，

cues.en: because Camira actually make these moquettes.
cues.zh: 因为这些织物其实就是 Camira 制造的。

cues.en: Anna Clough, what goes into the process of designing and manufacturing these moquettes?
cues.zh: 安娜·克拉夫，设计和制造这些织物要经过怎样的过程？

cues.en: So, a lot of time and effort obviously goes into the design work,
cues.zh: 首先，设计工作显然需要投入大量时间和精力，

cues.en: and you've got to think about hiding the sins, things like dirt and things like that,
cues.zh: 还得考虑如何掩饰污渍之类的瑕疵，

cues.en: But also with TfL, they always pay homage to something in the surroundings.
cues.zh: 而且对伦敦交通局来说，设计总会向周边环境中的某些元素致敬。

cues.en: So it might be the buildings, the Elizabeth line, for example, they chose the Royal Purple to celebrate the Queen.
cues.zh: 可能是建筑；比如伊丽莎白线，他们就选择皇家紫来纪念女王。

cues.en: And just very finally, very briefly, we don't have foreboding music to tell you when you're running out of time on this programme.
cues.zh: 最后简单说一句：节目快没时间时，我们没有不祥的音乐来提醒你。

cues.en: Emily, why should jaded Londoners who aren't into this stuff already be excited by moquettes? Very, very briefly.
cues.zh: 艾米莉，那些已经对伦敦生活感到厌倦、又没兴趣了解这些的人，为什么应该为 moquette 兴奋？请非常简短地回答。

cues.en: It's public design. I think we all deserve to be around stuff that's beautiful and connects us with the city around us.
cues.zh: 这是公共设计。我觉得我们都值得置身于美好的事物之中，与周围的城市产生联系。

cues.en: A lovely thought there from Emily Medhurst, and we also heard from fabric maker Anna Clough.
cues.zh: 艾米莉·梅德赫斯特的想法很美好；我们也听到了织物制造商安娜·克拉夫的分享。

cues.en: And before we go, we wanted to say hello to Raymond in Japan. He's a retired teacher, and he told us he listens every day,
cues.zh: 结束前，我们想向住在日本的 Raymond 问好。他是一名退休教师，告诉我们自己每天都收听节目，

cues.en: and that he really enjoys some of the lighter stories, like goat yoga, so much that he records them and shares them with his friends.
cues.zh: 而且非常喜欢山羊瑜伽之类的轻松故事，还会录下来与朋友分享。

cues.en: Are you listening in Japan, or do you also share your favourite stories? If so, we would love to hear from you.
cues.zh: 你是在日本收听吗？还是也会分享自己喜欢的故事？如果是，我们很期待听到你的来信。

cues.en: And that's it from us for now. If you want to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 以上就是今天的节目。如果想联系我们，可以发送邮件至 globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: You can also now watch our episodes in full, just search for the Global News Podcast on YouTube.
cues.zh: 现在也可以在 YouTube 上观看完整节目，只要搜索 Global News Podcast。

cues.en: This edition was mixed by Kai Perry, the producer was Charles Sanctuary, the editor is Karen Martin.
cues.zh: 本期混音：Kai Perry；制片人：Charles Sanctuary；编辑：Karen Martin。

cues.en: I'm Valerie Sanderson. Until next time, bye-bye.
cues.zh: 我是 Valerie Sanderson。下期再见。
